title: Early genetic signals connect diabetes subgroups to heart disease risk
desc: A growing body of research shows that diabetes can be stratified into five different subgroups. Researchers at Lund University have now investigated whether a person's genetic predisposition to different diabetes subgroups can help assess the risk of developing coronary artery disease.

title: Scientists just uncovered the secret behind nature’s “proton highway”
desc: Scientists have zoomed in on how phosphoric acid moves electrical charges so efficiently in both biology and technology. By freezing a key molecular pair to extremely low temperatures, they found it forms just one stable structure—contrary to predictions. This structure relies on a specific hydrogen-bond network that may be universal in similar systems. The discovery helps explain how protons travel so quickly and could inspire better energy materials.

title: Potential measles exposure at Calgary’s Rockyview hospital
desc: Alberta Health officials have issued a public alert for potential measles exposure at Rockyview General Hospital. Anyone who was in the hospital’s emergency room on April 4 between 10:27 a.m. and 6:17 p.m. may have been exposed to the highly contagious virus. Those born in or after 1970 who have received fewer than two documented doses of measles-containing vaccine, or who have never had measles, may be at risk of developing the disease. They are being advised to monitor for symptoms and review their immunization records.
